snippet.title: DrakkenRidge VR -  trailer - UHD
snippet.description:
VR Adventure game. https://www.meta.com/experiences/drakkenridge/6353835768070984/

You are a Hunter, a Novice of the Mage Order, an ancestral organization tasked with policing the usage of magic, particularly during the First Kingdoms’ War.
But now is a time of peace. The Order works as private militia, maintaining law and order, both on land and at sea.
You operate in the DrakkenRidge archipelago, a string of islands under the authority of the Duchy of Eaglemoore, located on Drakken Isle.

Core GamePlay:

- Change the Fate of DrakkenRidge by fulfilling the main quest and a trove of side-quests.
- Explore multiple islands and dungeons, solve puzzles and manipulate your environment.
- Cast spells using ancient runes.
- Use melee weapons (swords, axes, maces, daggers).
- Use bows and arrows or black powder guns.
- Craft or upgrade your equipment using the various workbenches in your Hunter’s lodge.
- Learn new schools of magic by acquiring essences from Bosses and fallen enemies.

For more information @ http://www.garage-collective.com
